cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your invisible guest is welcome at our wedding. I'll reserve places for invisible companions. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her family can walk through walls. They tend to wander.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll rent a ballroom that follows them. Nobody should miss cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our ballroom can split itself when guests wander apart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll order a cake that multiplies with it. Every room deserves the first slice.

mechanism: A hosts a wedding and keeps expanding venue and food commitments to accommodate increasingly strange guest abilities.
confusable: Unlike merely agreeing to an impossible guest, A answers each new offer with a larger provision justified by inclusion.
comparison: Invisible wandering guests and multiplying cake differ from a flying restaurant meal.
seedUse: D163-b invisible companions, following ballroom and splitting rooms; S02-b pays for adaptations rather than restricting the guests.
